data.name: Roads Beneath The Crown
data.detailed_description:
Beneath the Crown, no road is ever truly safe.

Roads Beneath the Crown is a single-player trading and management game set in a medieval fantasy world.

Begin with limited funds and travel between five distinct cities in search of opportunity. Study prices, understand supply and demand, gather intelligence, buy at the right moment, and carry your goods to the places that need them most.

But a merchant's life is about far more than buying low and selling high.

Master a Changing Market

Every city has its own goods, production, and demand.

Seasons, local events, policies, and shifting supply can reshape prices. An overlooked commodity today may become tomorrow's most valuable cargo somewhere else.

The market is unpredictable, but it is not meaningless.

Study price histories, gather information, and learn what is happening across the realm. Over time, patterns begin to emerge from the uncertainty.

Trade Beyond the Marketplace

As your capital grows, new opportunities begin to appear.

Enter auctions and compete for rare possessions.

Venture into the black market to find goods and artifacts unavailable through ordinary trade.

Acquire ancient relics and decide whether to sell them, keep them, or entrust them to scholars who may uncover their true value.

Use financial services offered by the merchant guild to expand your capital, but remember that every debt eventually comes due.

Wealth creates opportunities.

It also creates new risks.

Build Your Trading Network

You do not have to remain a lone merchant forever.

Recruit employees with different talents to assist with trading, intelligence, research, and other parts of your growing enterprise.

No single specialist is indispensable.

Different combinations of people create different advantages, leaving you to decide where your limited manpower and resources matter most.

As your business expands, you can grow from a travelling merchant personally carrying every shipment into the head of a commercial network spanning multiple cities.

Every Journey Has a Price

The roads are never completely safe.

Unexpected encounters, delays, and other events can disrupt even a carefully planned journey. Your cargo, money, reputation, and connections may all influence what happens next.

Sometimes the most profitable road is also the most dangerous.

You decide which risks are worth taking.

Become the Merchant You Choose to Be

Build your fortune through reliable trade.

Chase treasures through competitive auctions.

Step into the underground economy.

Study forgotten artifacts.

Create a commercial network stretching across the realm.

Or find your own place among the powers competing beneath the Crown.

Roads Beneath the Crown does not ask you to become one particular kind of merchant.

The roads belong to the Crown. How you travel them is up to you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 520 / AMD Radeon Vega 3 or equivalent
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Winsows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 520 / AMD Radeon Vega 3 or equivalent
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
